formats.key: Permit(address owner,address spender,uint256 value,uint256 nonce,uint256 deadline)
effects: Sets the signer's (owner's) USDC allowance for the spender to exactly `value`, replacing any earlier allowance (EIP2612._permit -> _approve(owner, spender, value)).
The signature can be used by anyone until `deadline`; a deadline of type(uint256).max never expires (EIP2612.sol line 85).
Uses up the owner's current permit nonce. No tokens move when the permit is signed.
formats.shown: Shows 'Authorize spending of tokens' with the spender address in raw form, the max amount in USDC (or 'Unlimited' at 2^255 or more), the valid-until date and the owner.

findings.title: Permit has no interpolatedIntent, so the intent line does not name the spender, amount or token.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json display.formats Permit: intent 'Authorize spending of tokens', no interpolatedIntent. The fields do show spender, value (tokenAmount) and deadline.
findings.fix: Add an interpolatedIntent such as 'Allow {spender} to spend up to {value} until {deadline}'.
